title: Response Stream Event
description: A single server-sent event emitted on the response stream. The `type` field discriminates the payload.

input.description: Array of input items (messages, function call outputs, etc.)

metadata.description: Developer-defined key-value pairs attached to the response (OpenAI spec: `Map<string, string>`).

output.description: Array of output items (messages, function calls, reasoning, etc.)

telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry trace and span identifiers for this response.

text.description: Text output configuration including format and verbosity

tool_choice.description: Tool choice setting: "auto", "none", "required", or a specific function

tools.description: Array of tool configurations used in this response

top_k.description: Only sample from the top K options for each subsequent token. Present only when set on the request.

input_cost.description: Cost (USD) of input tokens. Present when billing was computed for this response.

output_cost.description: Cost (USD) of output tokens. Present when billing was computed for this response.

server_tool_use.description: Per-tool breakdown of server tool calls (provider-native and orq-executed) made during this response.

total_cost.description: Total cost (USD) of the response. Present when billing was computed for this response.

effort.description: Constrains effort on reasoning for reasoning models. Reducing reasoning effort can result in faster responses and fewer tokens used on reasoning in a response.

summary.description: The format of the reasoning summary returned by the model.

item_id.description: ID of the output item this event refers to.

output_index.description: Index of the output item in the response output array.

sequence_number.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for ordering events.
